packageRules.description: Vendor-affecting deps: the committed vendor/ bundles must be rebuilt via `npm run build:vendor` in the same PR (check:vendor enforces it). Renovate cannot run that rebuild from repo config (postUpgradeTasks/allowedCommands are self-hosted-config territory), so these PRs are grouped and labeled for a manual rebuild. Automerge is off via the preset, so nothing lands unreviewed.
